title: Fix AdminGate infinite loading and add locked Owner indicator in admin UI

requirements.summary: Prevent /admin from spinning forever by detecting actor/admin-check unavailability and showing an actionable error state with retry.
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is authenticated and the backend actor is unavailable after initialization, the /admin route shows an error message in English (not an infinite loading spinner).
The error state provides a visible Retry action that re-attempts initializing the actor/admin check (or instructs the user to refresh) and does not require a full hard reload to re-attempt.
When the backend actor becomes available, the admin check proceeds and the gate transitions out of the error/loading state appropriately.
No changes are made to immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

file_operations.description: Expose actor initialization status needed for admin gating: include a stable "actorUnavailable"/"actorError" signal when identity is present but actor creation/initialization fails or returns null, and provide a Retry function (e.g., refetch) to re-attempt actor creation without a hard reload. This supports the authorization component’s access-control initialization flow. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Adjust admin-check query state to avoid the 'never fetched' condition when the actor is missing: surface a deterministic error/blocked state when authenticated but actor is unavailable, and expose a Retry action that re-triggers the actor/admin check. Ensure admin-check errors are represented distinctly from a real 'not admin' result (so AdminGate can render a proper error UI). This aligns with the authorization component’s guidance for handling actor dependency and errors. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update admin gating UI state machine: keep the existing loading state for true initialization, add an explicit error state when the user is authenticated but the actor/admin check cannot run (actor unavailable or initialization error), and render an English error message with a visible Retry button wired to the new retry/refetch behavior. Ensure it transitions back to loading and then to allowed/denied when the actor becomes available again.

requirements.summary: Add a read-only Owner indicator in the admin UI showing the locked owner email and label.
acceptanceCriteria: In the admin panel UI, there is a clearly visible row/card showing "traviscastonguay@gmail.com" with a lock icon and the text label "Owner".
The Owner email is rendered read-only: there are no edit inputs, no remove button, and no UI affordance that suggests it is editable.
All user-facing text is in English.
The Owner indicator renders consistently with existing admin styling (Tailwind/shadcn components), without modifying read-only UI component sources under frontend/src/components/ui.

file_operations.description: Create an admin-styled, read-only Owner indicator component that displays a lock icon, the label "Owner", and the fixed email "traviscastonguay@gmail.com" (no inputs/buttons that imply editability). Use existing Tailwind/shadcn-ui primitives already present in the app for consistent styling (do not modify frontend/src/components/ui). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Render the new AdminOwnerIndicator prominently within the admin access area so it appears in the admin panel UI. Keep the rest of the section behavior intact (it currently uses an unavailable placeholder), and ensure all text remains English.
